title_zh: 核对访客预约后等候带路

scenario.goal_zh: 核对预约并安排访客等候和前往会议室

context_zh: 访客索菲到办公室参加预约会议，但自助登记屏幕显示错误。
author: author-phase05-c

sentences.speaker: Sophie
sentences.text: The gentleman at the gate sent me here. I have a ten o'clock meeting with Elena Cruz.

sentences.speaker: Malik
sentences.text: That would be our security guard. May I have your full name?

sentences.speaker: Sophie
sentences.text: Sophie Lane. The screen says it cannot find my appointment. Should I ignore that and try signing in again?

sentences.speaker: Malik
sentences.text: No, I can check the booking here. Could you show me something that confirms your identity?

sentences.speaker: Sophie
sentences.text: Of course. Here is my driving licence and the invitation email.

sentences.speaker: Malik
sentences.text: Thank you. I can see your appointment now. Please take a seat while I tell Elena you are here.

sentences.speaker: Sophie
sentences.text: Is the meeting room on this floor?

sentences.speaker: Malik
sentences.text: It is upstairs. Elena has just replied; she will meet you here and take you up in a moment.
